scope: TASK-001 through TASK-030 acceptance subset; the supplied PRD remains the broader proposed catalog

requirements.text: Preserve publisher-scoped document identity separately from editions and packages.
Resolve identifiers conservatively and report ambiguity.
Pin evidence retrieval to an immutable installed edition package.
Preserve source bytes and validate their declared hashes.
Return exact evidence with required governing context.
Track required dependency context across retrieval and edition comparison.
Use portable data-only packs with explicit inventories.
Validate pack contracts strictly and reject unknown semantic fields.
Expose consistent structured read operations.
Do not split an atomic evidence unit to satisfy an output budget.
Traverse a declared obligation scope with stable pagination and coverage accounting.
Keep retrieval and derivation uncertainty explicit rather than converting it to approval.
Compare editions conservatively and surface dependency-context impacts.
Separate source rights claims from operational authorization.
Reauthorize every query against the installed digest grant.
Operate locally without network fallback or telemetry.
Keep administrative import separate from read-only queries.
Bind continuations to immutable snapshots, principals, and current policy state.
Treat indexes as rebuildable projections rather than evidence authority.
Expose detailed completeness dimensions and budget coverage.
Preserve stable official catalog metadata and verify locally acquired source bytes offline without embedding download behavior in query paths.
Compile verified PDFs deterministically while preserving raw source bytes separately from hashed extracted-text representations.
Expose text-layer, OCR, visual, table, figure, clause-boundary, and obligation-classification fidelity separately without inferring success.

Propagate declared pack coverage through search and retrieval, report source interpretation, dependency identification and retrieval, database traversal, and response fit separately, and provide a deterministic evidence-fetch path for every supported search result kind.

Represent reviewed document structure with stable edition-scoped logical identities, closed node kinds, typed relationships, and explicit unsupported regions, keeping content hashes and physical locations separate.
Bind structural nodes and relationship derivations to exact source spans over verified original bytes and hashed extracted page text, while keeping agent review and human approval distinct.

Offer an opt-in compact progressively expandable response profile with deterministic packet-local evidence, source, and derivation references; deduplicate source and derivation metadata without changing exact evidence text, canonical record IDs, completeness, authorization, or the default detailed JSON response.

Batch required-evidence retrieval and request-local source verification; use bounded versioned caches whose keys include content, traversal, corpus, ranking, and authorization visibility state; reauthorize and reverify integrity before return; and support explicit package- and clause-scoped lexical discovery without hidden fallback.

Verify every returned node and relationship evidence span against request-local immutable bytes; reuse verified bytes and decoded UTF-8 text within one request; batch obligation evidence assembly and edition-diff verification; and keep search filters, request echo, and exact evidence selectors replayable and truthful.

Reject inconsistent required-edge projections; bind compiled page evidence to exact byte spans; expose query limits without silently discarding constraints; and provide a measured concise evidence projection that retains exact text, citations, governing relationships, coverage, authorization, and expandable provenance.

Keep CI installation profiles dependency-complete, validate every declared JSON Schema against its metaschema, and validate representative success, continuation, profile, and typed-error responses against operation-specific machine contracts.

Bind every prepared distribution to an explicit machine-readable source baseline that records acquisition time, publisher, included document classes and status filters, component-selection and distribution rules, exclusions, acquisition and compilation failures, extraction gaps, and semantic-review coverage without presenting currentness as project approval.

Build release wheels twice from an exact source-file inventory under a fixed source epoch and pinned backend, require byte identity and an isolated install smoke, then bind the verified wheel and schema-validated build provenance into a deterministic prepared distribution.

Represent one reviewed logical structural node with an ordered, bounded set of non-overlapping exact source spans, reconstruct its text by a declared lossless assembly rule, and reverify every fragment and its assembled sidecar on each retrieval.

Represent a bounded reviewed semantic requirement packet with exact-span subject, action, modality, conditions, exceptions, and raw quantities; expose its review event without deciding applicability or approval; and retrieve required governing notes, definitions, table rows, headers, and footnotes through the declared transitive dependency graph.

Provide explicit exact-phrase, all-terms, and any-terms lexical discovery modes with all-terms compatibility default, bounded quoted compilation rather than raw query syntax, transparent parsed interpretation, authorization-safe mode-separated caching, and unchanged package-pinned evidence selectors.

Keep exact record identity authoritative in edition comparison, expose unique kind and clause-reference matches only as review-required non-authoritative candidates, distinguish source-only moves, and report deterministic side-qualified transitive required-dependency impact paths without constructing mixed-edition graph paths.

Define content-bound benchmark suites and schema-valid raw runs that keep synthetic contract qualification separate from human-reviewed real-document quality, preserve every failed case and metric denominator, gate wrong-edition, citation, critical-context, and false-completeness failures, and report unavailable quality, tokenizer, resource, and engineer-time dimensions as not measured rather than zero.

Provide a portable, non-mutating, offline doctor that reports runtime, SQLite/FTS, database schema, object-store, installed-package, authorization-policy, integrity-coverage, and optional MCP readiness through a closed machine contract without creating, migrating, repairing, or silently trusting local state.

Ship a deterministic cross-platform synthetic starter bundle whose closed manifest binds an independently verified wheel and provenance, exact fictional packs, trusted policy, portable setup and launcher, installed-state receipt, and offline readiness and evidence smokes without representing synthetic examples as real standards coverage.

Export one authorized package-pinned clause and its required governing context as a deterministic source-first reader and neutral engineering-handoff bundle that preserves exact evidence, locations, derivations, coverage, limitations, and host-owned undecided applicability and approval state without executing or trusting source content.

Emit deterministic, offline-verifiable release evidence that binds the exact reproducible wheel and starter archive to their build provenance, source revision, dependency lock, standards-based software bill of materials, and CI attestation identity without presenting unsigned local evidence as a signed attestation.

Run every untrusted PDF parser path in a disposable resource-limited worker with a closed digest-bound file protocol, deterministic output limits, fail-closed timeout and crash handling, and explicit incomplete-corpus outcomes for any extraction failure.

Version generated-artifact contracts explicitly, validate each schema against its metaschema and each representative emitted artifact against the exact matching schema, keep single-PDF and corpus extraction reports distinct, and reject unknown versions without inventing migration semantics.
